instruction: A cinematic fashion portrait photograph in a close-up shot at eye-level, set in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige wall. On the left, the red-haired woman in the beige striped blazer (R1) stands facing forward, looking down with a soft, neutral expression, her head tilted to the right to rest against the cheek of the blonde woman in the dark grey blazer (R2). The blonde woman (R2) stands facing forward, her head tilted slightly to the left, looking directly at the camera with a serious, neutral expression. Their faces touch closely. Harsh, direct sunlight streams from the upper left, casting sharp diagonal shadows across the subjects and the background wall, creating a warm, muted color palette.
elements: R1 tilts her head to rest against R2's cheek
R2 remains upright enough to face forward and look directly at the camera while R1 looks down
R1 and R2 have their faces touching closely
R2 tilts her head slightly toward R1 during the cheek contact
minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige wall
harsh direct sunlight casts sharp diagonal shadows
